_comment: Map 211292160 = «Forbidden Inn Great Hall» [23,-32], subarea 960: an indoor client map without
monsters, without NPCs of its own and named by no other content file; 163 walkable cells.
Checked again (docs/stasis-maps.md): no quest, zaap or dungeon uses it; «cell» 316 and the four
NPC cells are walkable and on its main floor (MapManager.MainFloor), reached by the Inn's doors.
The NPCs are placed by content/npcs/spawns.json on the same cells as here; talking to the
merchant, the raffineur or the counter answers with their command's text (role), the banker
(Bonta's template 6394) opens the bank as every banker does.
merchant: plain equipment at ReferencePrices worth x priceFactor (Orbes), level bands of
bandWidth; consumables with a price written (kamas-calibrated) or their worth; breedElements
choose the «Conseillé» element by breed when the player names none.
